notes: High-level: InsightLoom is an enterprise SaaS provider of in-app help centers and intelligent KB search for mid-market+ customers. They plan to migrate from a hybrid Elastic + in-house re-ranker to a managed embedding + reranking stack.

POC ask: hosted API only for now — want to test scale and unit economics before considering Dedicated. Primary focus: embeddings + lightweight reranker (cross-encoder fallback) for KB search and support triage.
Indexing scale: moderate — initial index ~750k docs (articles, transcripts, product pages). Expect incremental growth 10-15%/month. Need guidance on shard sizing and embedding storage costs.

QPS/latency targets: sustain 600-800 qps peak for simple vector search (ANN + re-rank), target p50 < 40ms for vector retrieval and end-to-end (including re-ranker) p95 < 180ms. Concerned about p99 spikes during business hours.

Cost sensitivity: unit target cost per query (embedding + rerank) <= $0.005 for pilot; long-term target < $0.002 with batching/caching optimizations. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching & quantization.

Model preferences: open/Redwood-curated models OK. Want to test a two-tier routing: cheaper quantized embedding model for retrieval + stronger cross-encoder for rerank on top-k candidates. Automatic fallback to lower-cost model under load.
Security/compliance: SOC2 required for procurement; SSO (SAML) mandatory; audit logs and encryption keys (KMS) required. Also asking about EU data residency for some customers.
